// useTimeSeconds: How long the smoke animation runs. Vanilla food sits between 2 and 9 seconds.
// smokesPerPack: Uses per pack, shown as a resource bar like a water bottle. Set to 1 to consume the whole pack in one go.
// effects: Applied per smoke. Energy is satiety in EFT, so a small gain reads as nicotine blunting hunger.
// itemSound: Sound key used when consumed. 'generic' is what cigarettes already carry; 'food_snack' and 'drink' also exist.
// useInHandsPrefab: Model held while smoking. Cigarettes have no in-hands model of their own - an empty value here breaks the player's hands. Must be a usable_items prefab. Alternatives: item_galette/item_galette_container.bundle, item_snacks/item_snacks_borodynsky_container.bundle, item_chocolate/item_alyonka_container.bundle
// buff: Effects applied after smoking. Registered into globals under 'name' and referenced by the cigarettes. Set enabled to false for no buff. Leave entries empty and point name at a vanilla group to reuse one instead.
// buffTypes: SkillRate (needs skillName), StaminaRate, MaxStamina, EnergyRate, HydrationRate, HealthRate, Pain, WeightLimit, BodyTemperature.
